checks.clean_text: Files checked: {files}. No problems of the mod's own.
checks.empty_no_project: Open a mod in Home to validate it.
checks.empty_text: Press “Validate mod” (F7) to check the whole mod against the game's rules: broken references, unregistered countries, missing texts… Problems the base game or the mod's dependencies already have show as inherited and do not count.
checks.export_tooltip: Packs the saved mod into a clean zip to share it (Ctrl+E). Mod errors block it.
checks.failed_title: The mod could not be validated
checks.filter_placeholder: Filter by message, entity or file…
checks.fix_none_tooltip: This problem has no automatic fix
checks.fix_read_only_tooltip: The project is read-only: it cannot be fixed.
checks.fix_tooltip: {fix}: shows the change plan first and asks for confirmation (other fixes under the arrow)
checks.fix_wait_tooltip: Wait for the new report: the last change is still being validated.
checks.hint: Double-click or press Enter on a problem to open the file at that line.
checks.inherited_hidden: Inherited from the base game or the dependencies, hidden: {count}.
checks.inherited_tooltip: Inherited: the base game or a dependency already has this problem; it is not the mod's fault.
checks.no_baseline: No baseline: the base game's problems cannot be told apart from the mod's.
checks.no_baseline_reason: No baseline ({error}): the base game's problems cannot be told apart from the mod's.
checks.retry_baseline_tooltip: Computes the base game's baseline again and validates again
checks.show_inherited_tooltip: Problems the base game or the mod's dependencies already have are hidden: the mod did not cause them
checks.stale: There are changes since the last validation: press F7 to validate again.
checks.status_cancelled: Validation cancelled: the previous report, if any, is still shown.
checks.status_done: Validation finished in {seconds} s — errors: {errors} · warnings: {warnings} · notes: {infos}
checks.status_explain_failed: The problem could not be explained: {error}
checks.status_failed: The mod could not be validated: {error}
checks.status_fix_applied: Fix applied: {fix}. Ctrl+Z undoes it; it is saved with everything else.
checks.status_fix_wait: Wait for the new report before fixing: the last change is still being validated.
checks.status_no_fix: This problem has no automatic fix.
checks.status_started: Validating the mod in the background…
checks.summary: Files checked: {files} in {seconds} s — errors: {errors} · warnings: {warnings} · notes: {infos}.
checks.validate_tooltip: Checks the whole mod against the game's rules, in the background (F7)
checks.why_tooltip: Explains which layers define the same thing, which one wins and what the player will see
fixplan.confirm: I understand this fix deletes or replaces content (anything deleted goes to the project trash)
fixplan.intro: The fix changes {count} files. Nothing is written to disk until you save, and Ctrl+Z undoes it in one step.
fixplan.intro_one: The fix changes {count} file. Nothing is written to disk until you save, and Ctrl+Z undoes it in one step.
fixplan.nothing: This fix would change nothing right now.
fixplan.trash_note: {file} will go to the project trash (.vic2studio/trash) when you save: nothing is really deleted.
fixplan.unsafe: This fix deletes or replaces content: review the plan before applying it.
